scope: Final Stage-2 authority and the pinned PhysicsNeMo linked-source snapshot were inspected statically. Framework capabilities, environment variants, historical Atlas relationship scope, license, symbolic PDE functionality and heterogeneous support assets are source-scoped without manufacturing example-level experiments.

unresolved_findings.finding: The current PhysicsNeMo framework is substantially broader than the historical PINN-toolbox scope associated with Atlas review paper 367; Stage 3 preserves that scope distinction.
The product web resource has no immutable commit SHA; technical source claims are bounded to the Stage-2-authoritative linked repository snapshot.
The package supports multiple CUDA and optional-dependency variants, so the root manifest does not define one universal runtime for every component.
Example-specific requirement files and optional feature groups are not normalized into a single environment specification.
Examples, tests, reference values, normalization files, model/test assets, and external dataset workflows are heterogeneous support materials and cannot be represented as one standalone dataset.
No framework-wide experiment, hyperparameter set, seed, expected-result target, or benchmark execution is established by the bounded static assessment.

notes: No scientific software, notebook, model, dataset, training, inference, evaluation, test, runtime environment, dependency installation, container, accelerator or benchmark workload was executed.
